feat(#1701): Add Usage column to the feed inventory emailed report
nodes.description:
### Available on [dev5](https://dev5.chandlerhardy-dev.performancebeef.com/)
### Closes #1701

Adds a **Usage** column to the emailed inventory alert report, between **Amount Remaining** and **Estimated Days Left**, showing that work-date's usage for each alertable item (`InventoryLedger::getItemUsageForPeriod`, single-day window). Displays **"No recent usage"** when the day's usage is zero — including when a small positive usage would *round* to a displayed "0" (weight rounding settings). Formatting/pluralization mirrors the Amount Remaining cell exactly (separators, cc/mL exemption); email cells copy the sibling inline styles byte-for-byte.

**Verify:** 13 exact-assertion unit tests on the extracted `formatUsageCell` helper with mutation falsification (guard inversion, cc/mL exemption deletion, RED→GREEN on the rounding fix). MAGI tribunal (Claude/Codex/Seneschal): SHIP 3/3 after 1 fix round. Live QA on dev5 (Allie): report preview renders `Feed | Amount Remaining | Usage | Estimated Days Left` with real values ("2,973 lbs", "28 lbs") and "No recent usage" empty states across both categories.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Inventory report emails now include a separate Usage column for alertable items.
  * Usage reflects consumption over the previous day and follows configured number formatting.
  * Zero or negligible usage is displayed as “No recent usage.”
  * Measurement labels are formatted consistently, including correct singular and plural forms across supported units.

nodes.title: feat(#1700): Add ability to hide Kill Sheet information
nodes.description:
### Available on [dev4](https://dev4.chandlerhardy-dev.performancebeef.com/)
### Closes #1700

Adds a **Kill Sheet Data Points** dropdown (Show/Hide, default Show) to Account Settings > System Settings. When set to Hide:

- The **Expand Dressed** button + kill sheet section are not rendered in the +/- Head Sell form and the Edit Sale form (shared `_sold_fields.php` gate — fields absent from the DOM, not CSS-hidden).
- The 28 packer-derived columns are omitted from the read-only **Sheets > Sold Head** view (`Head_sold::setHideKillSheetColumns`, mirroring the #1489 `include_edit_button` flag; filters by name/key so the two flags compose in either order).
- Save paths treat an **absent** packer key as "no change": head-count edits recalibrate stored per-head hot weight/base price from the original total, and Destination stays required while a hidden packer record exists — an existing `group_packer_info` record can never be wiped or orphaned by a Hide-mode save.

**Known limitations (by design):** the CSV export keeps the full column set (data extract, not a display surface); the gate is render-time, so a tab opened before flipping the setting can still post packer values (the absent-key save tolerance keeps such posts from corrupting stored records). The bulk Edit sheet is now gated too (review round, R-1).

**Verify:** 133 targeted PHPUnit tests (exact-array column assertions, child-process partial renders in both modes/hosts, 16-row per-head-source truth table, source-scan wiring guards) + mutation falsification on every new guard. MAGI tribunal (Claude/Codex/Seneschal + 3-agent specialist panel): SHIP after 1 fix round. Browser QA on dev5 (Allie): setting renders, saves, persists, both directions. Live sheet/form checks were blocked by pre-existing dev5 data corruption (`work_dates` doc `6a6c3388a405abcd00000000` has double-typed `target_pounds`; pb-api 500s on decode — repair script ready, unrelated to this MR). Not verified on a metric (kg) account: the per-head recompute unit round-trip.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **New Features**
  - Added a Kill Sheet Data Points setting to show or hide optional Kill Sheet fields.
  - Applied the preference across sales forms, read-only views, tables, and saved records.
  - Event-related information remains visible when optional fields are hidden.

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Omitted optional fields now retain existing values instead of being cleared.
  - Improved destination validation and per-head recalculation when quantities change.
  - Save failures now show row-level errors and remain retryable.

nodes.title: Draft: refactor(#1681): analytics feed-data debt — compute seam (M10), shared snapshot, work-date cache, breakdown guards
nodes.description:
Addresses #1681 (items 1, 2, 4 + the two optional guard candidates; item 3 — mongodb ext on dev/CI — is runner-host ops and stays open on the issue).

**Stacked on !3995** (`feat/796-nem-neg-analytics`): items 1–2 modify code that only exists there. This MR targets that branch so the diff shows only #1681 work; GitLab auto-retargets to `master` when !3995 merges. **Hold merge until !3995 lands.**

## Summary

- **Item 2 — compute seam (M10):** the per-date feed compute loop is extracted from `Analytics::getDailyFeedData` into `AnalyticsFeedDaily::compute` (statically callable, no DB/session deps — sibling pattern `AnalyticsNEmNEg`). `getDailyFeedData` is now fetch-then-delegate. Surviving mutation M10 is dead **by execution**: substituting the head-divided energy at the `dailySeries` call site fails 5 tests (`14.0` vs `56.0` — off by exactly the fixture's head count).
- **Item 1 — torn read:** the reshaped growth CSV export now fetches ONE raw FeedSheets snapshot and threads it into both `GrowthModel::buildModel` and `getDailyFeedData` (new trailing optional `$sheetData` param). Root-cause prerequisite: `buildModel`'s fallback `$groups` fetch now projects `field=status` — previously the closed-group end-date narrowing (`Sheets.php:137`) could never fire on the model-fed read (undefined `'status'` key on PHP 8) while it did fire on Analytics' own read, making the two reads non-equivalent for closed+0-head groups. A 21-row call-site characterization found no consumer affected beyond the narrowing semantics (`AddedCost` computes but never reads its range; the added key is shape-safe everywhere).
- **Item 4 — P×D→D:** `PenMongo::getRationsForDate` now passes `add_to_cache: true` (sibling: `getRations`, PenMongo:102) so the per-feedyard-day work-date document is fetched once per date instead of once per (pen × date) — ~5,000 → ~250 fetches for a 20-pen/250-day group. Deliberately **no field projection**: the shared identity map records nothing about projections, so caching a projected doc would hand later consumers incomplete documents (`RationSheet.php:146` already does a projected, non-cached read).
- **Guards:** the DMAF and health `chartTypeChanged` breakdown-default lookups get the same null-safe guard shape as NEm/NEg (6ae6697fbc); the inverted tripwire test is flipped to assert all three branches guarded.

## Key decisions

- Extraction over DI: `Analytics`' constructor is DB-bound even with `$build=false`, so no injected collaborator could reach the unit env — a pure static compute unit can.
- `buildModel`'s loose `$sheetData == null` gate is intentionally preserved (14 other call sites depend on empty-array-refetch semantics); `getDailyFeedData` uses strict `??=`.
- `getTargetData`'s FeedData read stays a separate read set — full multi-collection snapshot consistency needs machinery that doesn't exist; residual window documented.

## Verification

- UnitTests: 936 → 957 tests; Errors 69 / Failures 1 / Skipped 80 / Risky 38 — unchanged from baseline (pre-existing API-connectivity).
- Mutation receipts: M10 (1→6→1 failures across apply/revert); ordering falsifier (snapshot fetched before model build); `field=status` revert; `??=`→`==` swap; projection-added and cache-arg-dropped mutants for item 4; per-branch guard reverts. All killed.
- **dev2 (base) vs dev3 (this branch), shared Mongo, 12-probe SHA-256 battery: 12/12 byte-identical** — NEm/NEg/DMAFBW/DMAFH charts and reshaped + raw CSVs, on open AND closed groups. The closed-group identity shows the `field=status` change produces no output delta on real data (the narrowed post-closure window holds no emitted rows), so nightly-cron model rebuilds converge as a no-op here.
- Live guard check on dev3: five chart-type switches (NEm/DMAF/health/health_compared/NEg), correct breakdown defaults, zero JS errors.

## Known / carried forward

- `WorkDateMongo::$cache_by_work_date` has no `feedyard_id` component — safe per-request, but `cron/update_sheets_for_users.php` iterates all feedyards in one process. Pre-existing hazard (multiple populate sites already exist), widened by this MR's third; **now tracked as #1681 item 5** (filed 2026-07-29 with the cron trace from review).
- `Group.php:2244`'s "stop at today to catch post-sale feeding" comment already disagreed with its own code; the narrowing convergence brushes against it — worth a follow-up read, not blocking.

nodes.title: feat(#796): NEm and NEg Analytics Adjustments
nodes.description:
### Available on [https://dev2.chandlerhardy-dev.performancebeef.com](https://dev2.chandlerhardy-dev.performancebeef.com)
### Closes #796

## Summary

- NEm/NEg charts gain a **Per CWT / Per Head** breakdown, defaulting to **Per CWT** (delivered ration energy density, Mcal per CWT of dry-matter intake — matches the as-entered ration NEm convention). Per-Head behavior unchanged, including its Target line.
- Chart-type labels stripped of "(per Head)"; titles and axis units are breakdown-aware (`NEm - {group/pen} - {breakdown}`).
- The admin **NEm/NEg** CSV export (only — the other six growth charts keep the raw model dump) is reshaped into a consultant worksheet: removed Ideal/Breed/Gender/Temperature/Wind/Model Gender; added **Target As Fed, DMI Target, Ration**; retitled Start→Projected Weight, DMI→DMI As Fed, NEm→NEm As Fed, NEg→NEg As Fed, with each Target column beside its As-Fed counterpart in matching units (raw-lb basis; metric feedyards' targets reconciled by the delivery conversion factor).

## Deliberate deviation from the issue (product please confirm)

The issue's CSV add-list included **Target NEm / Target NEg**, and the original implementation shipped them — the review panel then proved the per-CWT target math is **degenerate**: the pipeline has no formulated target-energy source (`getTargetData` returns weight targets only), so the "Target" density algebraically ≈ the actual density whenever the ration is fed near its card. Decision (user-gated 2026-07-29): **drop the Target series on Per CWT** (chart) and the two energy Target columns (CSV) rather than ship two near-identical columns that read as "always on target". A real target-energy series would need the ration card's formulated composition — its own issue if wanted.

## Hardening picked up by the review panel (this MR)

- CSV formula injection (CWE-1236) neutralized on **all three** export branches of `downloadAnalytics.php` (Ration cells, pie first-cell/series headers, generic headers) — tenant-authored free text reaches higher-privileged consultants' spreadsheets.
- `Content-Disposition` filename sanitized (quote/control-char/path stripping; pre-existing gap).
- Join-miss vs genuine-zero distinguishable in the CSV (blank vs `0.0` — survives `fputcsv` to the byte level).
- Re-clicking the already-active NEm/NEg tile no longer silently resets a deliberate Per Head choice.
- `FeedData` per-pen loaders memoized (P× unbounded Mongo finds → 1×); `memory_limit` raised only for the growth-model branch; weight factor read through the live `Analytics` instance (kills a hidden-static ordering trap that would have silently broken metric feedyards under future refactors).

## Verification

- `php -l` clean on all changed files. Full UnitTests suite: **914 tests — 69 errors / 1 failure, byte-identical to the pre-MR baseline** (pre-existing API-connectivity cases; verify tail on request).
- 77 targeted PHPUnit tests (RED→GREEN TDD ordering), **15 mutation classes applied to real source and observed to fail** — full per-mutant receipts (mutant → diff → failing assertion) posted as an MR note.
- One surviving mutation is **declared, not hidden** (M10: a deliberate wrong-variable substitution at the unit-unreachable `getDailyFeedData` call site; compensating characterization test exists).
- Full 8-lane review panel (architect, security, data-integrity, test-quality, design, perf, simplifier, frontend-ux) + scoped re-reviews; TQS 63→72.
- **Not yet browser-verified on dev2** (menu default, rendered title, per-CWT axis magnitude ≈ as-entered ration NEm, live CSV pull) — flagged for QA before merge.
- Val gate: `VAL_UNAVAILABLE` (Val binary not yet deployed); waived with the mutation receipts standing in.

## Known accepted gaps / follow-ups — tracked in #1681

1. **Torn read on the CSV export**: three independent Mongo reads merged per request (GrowthModel sheets, Analytics sheets, targets FeedData) — a mid-request ration edit can produce a self-contradictory row. Narrow window, admin-only path; a shared-snapshot fix is a real refactor, not a patch.
2. **Pre-existing P×D work-date fetch** under `getTargetData` (`PenMongo::getRationsForDate` doesn't populate the WorkDateMongo cache): ~5,000 unprojected full-document fetches per large-group export — and the production chart paths already pay this today. Fix touches shared caching machinery; needs its own issue.
3. `getPropertiesForFeedItems` remains unbounded-lower-date **by design** (carry-forward history semantics — a naive bound silently zeroes unchanged items; documented in-code).
4. `MicroRationData` copy-paste twin of the memoized FeedData loaders not updated (kept surgical).

nodes.title: refactor(applied-costs): drop deprecated `type: "typical"` and align writes with pb-api !744 unified schema (#1564)
nodes.description:
### Closes #1564. Merges independently of pb-api !744 (dual-schema); !744 still requires this MR.

Drops the deprecated `type: "typical"` discriminator from `animals.applied_costs` **creates** and aligns pb-www's write shape with !744's unified `AppliedCost` struct: `{_id, application_dtz, inventory_event_id, type?}`. **Update 2026-07-20 (dual-schema, per Leif):** edit PATCHes now **re-carry the stored `type`** (passthrough of `"typical"`/`"converted"`, truthy-guarded so lean rows stay type-less), so this MR works against BOTH current-production pb-api (which locates typed rows *by* the payload's `type` — a type-less PATCH 404s, verified on dev3 2026-07-14) and !744 (where `type` is an optional passthrough). **This MR deploys first; !744 whenever it's ready.** The reverse dependency still holds: !744 needs this MR (see Sequencing).

## What it does

**Write side — Create AND Edit, Health Animal + Bulk Updater (4 sites):**
- Create: cost row carries only `{_id, application_dtz, inventory_event_id}` — no `type` stamp (both API versions accept type-less creates), and `dose`/`inventory_id`/`price_cents`/`divisor` are stripped off the write.
- Edit: same lean shape **plus the stored row's `type` re-stamped via `editTypeStamp` (unconditional per edit, before the typical-branch guard — the invariant "an edit PATCH carries the stored discriminator" is structural)**. Lean rows hydrate `type: null` and stay type-less.
- The dose rides a linked `inventory_events` document as `diff = -1 * dose`; Create pre-stamps a fresh `inventory_event_id`, Edit reuses or creates one.

**Read side:**
- `isTypicalCost(cost)` gate treats explicit `type === "typical"`, type-less, AND `type === "converted"` rows as typical — rows created by today's create path have no `type`, and !744's `animalcostmigration` stamps `"converted"` on rows it converts from the legacy dose-on-row shape. Inline per module — the legacy jQuery module system has no shared imports.
- Lean rows hydrate `inventory_id`/`dose` from the linked inventory_event (`dose = -diff`) for display and for the partial-edit fallback. Hydration hinges on `inventory_event_id` + missing `inventory_id`, never on `type`. Bulk Updater fetches the feedyard's inventory_events once per page load.

**Inventory-corruption guards (found by Cursor Bugbot + cross-model review during this MR; the partial-edit variant exists in master today):**
- Partial edit (date/divisor-only): `dose` falls back to the hydrated existing row — never writes `diff: -1` over a real event.
- Legitimate `0` dose writes `diff: 0` (bulk dose input has no `min`, so zeros reach the write path).
- Unresolvable dose: user-facing error and the row is skipped **before either write is queued**, so the cost row and its linked event cannot diverge.

`$script_version` bumped → `simmental` (note: master has since moved to `simmental26`; the catch-up merge will resolve this line with a fresh breed name).

### Available on https://dev1.chandlerhardy-dev.performancebeef.com — currently running this branch against **pb-api master** (the independent-merge configuration)

## Sequencing — this MR merges first; !744 lands whenever

| Payload (who writes it) | current pb-api | pb-api !744 |
|---|---|---|
| typed edit PATCH carrying the stored `type` — **this MR** | ✅ (typed `$elemMatch` matches) | ✅ (`_id`-only match, `type` passthrough) |
| lean edit PATCH on a lean row — **this MR** | ✅ (`$exists:false` matches) | ✅ |
| lean Create (`PUT` + inventory_event) — **this MR** | ✅ (legacy AH-shape accepts it) | ✅ |
| fat write carrying `divisor`/`dose`/`inventory_id`/`price_cents` — **master pb-www's create path, NOT this MR** | ✅ (legacy struct) | ❌ 400 (`DisallowUnknownFields`) |

The last row is why **!744 still needs this MR**: master's create path breaks the moment !744 deploys. This MR carries no such dependency in the other direction — the dual-schema stamp makes every write valid against both API versions. !744's migration then normalizes stored documents at its own pace.
